title: Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills
author: Andrea Griffiths
description: Agent skills capture repeatable engineering work in files teams can review and reuse, while tools, project context, and permissions remain specific to the host that runs them. The post Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: How many times this week did you re-explain the same task to an agent? How many times did you ask your colleague with deep institutional knowledge how to solve a specific problem?
takeaways: Coordinate multiple skills for a larger workflow When the judgment that makes a data pipeline correct lives in four different people’s heads, those four people are the roadmap.
Skills fit bounded, repeatable work that benefits from reusable judgment, such as a checklist, release, migration, or metric pipeline.
Agent skills let you capture repeatable instructions so you and your agents can reuse them.
